title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Smoking Gun
A police shootout leaves a paroled inmate in the hospital with 14 bullet wounds and two other men are arrested for their connection to him; a female inmate arrives with what she says is a hair salon mishap, but officers suspect something else.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Going Postal
A new inmate tries to adjust to life in jail, but finds himself with a target on his back and the victim of violence; a drug smuggling scheme is uncovered in the jail's mailroom and a suspect is identified.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Mama's Boy Drug
A dangerous drug makes a comeback in the city of Hackensack, but this time with an "all in the family" twist; inmates are provided with cameras to record their intimate thoughts.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — God Is Not Here
A familiar face struggles to escape the jail's revolving door, but there's a catch; another inmate has pled guilty to manslaughter, but now in an unusual legal twist, he may have to stand trial for murder.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E2 — Never a Dull Moment
Our Lockup crews have found out many times that you never know when things will detonate.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E12 — Trouble in Tulsa
The troublemakers of the jail system and how correctional officers control the situation caused by these troublemakers.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hard on the Yard
One man prepares for life behind bars after running someone down with his car; another man must be placed in isolation for his own protection, after being accused of knowingly giving women HIV.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Do Not Pass Go
The communities in Fairfax County, Virginia, have become some of the wealthiest and fastest growing in the nation, due in part to low crime rates, and, as one deputy says, taking care of the "little things" so "you don't have the big things.".

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Counterfeit Lives
A self-described white supremacist may not be who he says he is and that could make him a marked man among other white supremacists; another inmate attempts to hide the true nature of his recent conviction.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — High Profile
A surprise attack on a sheriff's deputy takes an unexpected turn, a convicted rapist loses his cool in court and an accused murderer in a high profile case tries to cash in on her notoriety.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Killing Time
Boredom reigns supreme for prisoners who spend endless hours, days and months confined to their cells; some have devised creative ways to pass the time; one inmate is creating a wall mural, but not with real art supplies.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Bad Boys, Bad Boys
Inside San Quentin, gangs, drugs and sheer boredom make up a violent mix; Scanvinski Hymes has been in prison since he was 18 years old; almost 20 years later, he's racked up the highest number of violent offenses in California prison history.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E1 — Lasting Impressions
Up-close and personal with transgender inmates, and inmates with dreams of stardom.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E3 — Living the Life
The price of crime is often paid by the most innocent, by creativity wasted on destructive ends, but some inmates are determined to better themselves and adapt to life in prison.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Reap What You Sow
A cell search inside the maximum-security prison results in some heated words and the discovery of a gang manifesto; inmates express their personal feelings in private to the cameras; one confronts his own mortality.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Damage Done
Inside Florida's toughest maximum-security prison a convicted murderer breaks down the ways of prison, while a young, fresh-faced inmate learns about them; another inmate mails a death threat to the White House and then carries out a shocking act.
